scope: Independent read-only source review of the CPU preflight supervisor only; Blender import and render remain blocked. No process launched by this reviewer.

checks.fixed_worker: D Python with -I -B runs preflight.py; only preflight stage is accepted. No Blender command is reachable.
checks.identity_binding: Exact HEAD/branch and helper pins; all candidate Python source names and hashes, plan, focused log, importer audit and installed importer source hashes must match the independent review.
checks.resources: Pinned original helper requires available RAM >=12GiB and free disk >=2GiB before marker and during child execution.
checks.ownership: Windows JobObject process and aggregate committed-memory caps are both 6GiB; worker receives exact binary GO only after job attachment.
checks.deadline: 180-second execution bound; owned descendants must settle naturally inside deadline.
checks.exclusivity: Output, attempt marker and host receipt must be absent before the one diagnostic attempt; outputs use exclusive creation.
checks.cleanup: Job cleanup always runs; PASS requires no forced job cleanup, verified owned-tree exit, zero child return code, unchanged source snapshots and measured memory peaks <=6GiB.
checks.semantic_receipt: A successful diagnostic must still report import_verdict=visual_verdict=BLOCKED and Blender_imports=Blender_renders=0.
